subject.title: Support Workers AI model selection during onboard

question: Should the bundled Cloudflare AI Gateway auth choice grow a Workers AI/REST model-selection mode during onboarding, or should OpenClaw only document the generic custom-provider route for Workers AI?
rationale: The implementation choice affects CLI flags, generated config shape, provider auth/header semantics, model catalog metadata, and compatibility with existing Anthropic gateway setups, which automation should not choose without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add provider-owned Workers AI onboarding
options.body: Add an explicit Cloudflare plugin mode or selector that emits the correct Workers AI REST/OpenAI-compatible config while preserving existing Anthropic gateway behavior.

options.title: Document custom-provider setup only
options.body: Keep `cloudflare-ai-gateway-api-key` Anthropic-only and publish a supported custom-provider command for Workers AI users.

options.title: Fold into the broader bridge design
options.body: Treat this as a sub-requirement of the open Cloudflare AI Gateway bridge work and keep implementation paused until that contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Add provider-owned Workers AI onboarding
recommendation.body: Add an explicit Cloudflare plugin mode or selector that emits the correct Workers AI REST/OpenAI-compatible config while preserving existing Anthropic gateway behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest history match for the original provider landing and current extension-boundary shape.
